meta.notes: Every metric reproduces a canonical query supplied by the business. ORDERS: view_reports.oms_sales_union, date window only, no status or validity filters, no deduplication; total order value = SUM(sales); AOV = SUM(sales)/COUNT(DISTINCT order_id). LEADS: temp.source_wise_funnel, one row per phone, pincode column `pincodes`, cohort anchored on created_on, restricted to mapping IN ('Ho','Store') -- which excludes 1,072,364 'Test' leads plus Support, BD, Progressive and NULL. CONVERSION: read straight off the lead row as Total_Orders > 0; no join to orders is involved, so a lead who ordered from any pincode or phone still counts. The previous phone-join definition is kept as config/schema.mapping.phonejoin.json. WINDOW: rolling 6 months ending on the pull date; METRICS_PERIOD_ANCHOR=week advances the pull date weekly, so the window follows the refresh cadence. NOTE: source_wise_funnel lives in the `temp` dataset, so a production metric depends on a scratch namespace.
